name: Forest Of Glass
source:
Forest Of Glass is an interactive fantasy romance visual novel with two romance options 1 male and 1 female.  Play as a nameable non-binary protagonist trying to stay safe in a world of monsters and magic.  

[From [url=https://forestofglass.itch.io/forest-of-glass]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《玻璃森林》是一部互动奇幻浪漫视觉小说，有两种浪漫选择：一男一女。扮演一个有名的非二元主角，试图在充满怪物和魔法的世界中保持安全。

[来自[url=https://forestofglass.itch.io/forest-of-glass]Itch.io[/url]]
